backend.startup_procedure: @app.on_event('startup') attaching DB session factory to alert_engine

database.session_lifecycle: FastAPI get_db dependency yielding SessionLocal and closing in finally block

authentication_and_authorization.coordinator_authentication: Shared static COORDINATOR_API_KEY verified via secrets.compare_digest in backend/app/api/deps.py; fails closed with HTTP 503 in production if unset
authentication_and_authorization.public_endpoints: Fully anonymous / unauthenticated (emergency requests, field reports, alerts, GIS)

ai_ml_architecture.numerical_ml: XGBoost classifier in xgb_calibration.py and backend/app/services/spatial_analysis.py
ai_ml_architecture.multimodal_vision: GemmaAnalysisService in backend/app/services/gemma_analysis_service.py using GoogleGenAIProvider or OllamaProvider via backend/app/services/gemma_providers.py

frontend_web.router_architecture: Next.js App Router (100% in frontend/src/app; no pages directory)
frontend_web.api_client: apiFetch<T> in frontend/src/lib/api.ts with dynamic host resolution via getApiBaseUrl()
frontend_web.ui_styling: Tailwind CSS v4 with Lucide React icons, Framer Motion, and custom CSS variables

mobile_app.api_client: apiClient in landslide-app/src/services/api/client.ts targeting API_CONFIG in apiConfig.ts
mobile_app.authentication_status: Simulated/mock UI in landslide-app/src/screens/ProfileLoginScreen.tsx with no backend API integration

backboard_client_configuration.rationale: Follows the pattern established in backend/app/database/config.py and gemma_providers.py, loading secrets safely from backend/.env without exposing them to client bundles.

rag_service_location.protocol_interface: BackboardProvider protocol in backend/app/services/backboard/providers.py with MockBackboardProvider for offline unit tests
rag_service_location.rationale: Mirrors the existing GemmaAnalysisService and AnalysisProvider abstraction in backend/app/services/gemma_analysis_service.py and gemma_providers.py, enabling deterministic testing without live API keys.

endpoints.summary: Submit a question to the Backboard RAG assistant

api_endpoint_registration.rationale: Maintains strict consistency with existing routers (/api/alerts, /api/field-reports) registered in backend/app/main.py.

conversation_thread_association.short_term_approach: Client-generated UUIDv4 session ID passed in X-Session-ID header, mapped to Backboard thread ID in an in-memory TTL cache or Redis instance. Suitable for anonymous public educational Q&A.
conversation_thread_association.long_term_approach: Alembic migration creating a chat_threads table (id UUID, user_id UUID FK users.id, backboard_thread_id TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMP) combined with introducing genuine user authentication.
conversation_thread_association.risk_note: Without user authentication, conversation threads cannot be cryptographically bound to specific human users.

frontend_request_routing.optional_bff_proxy: frontend/src/app/api/assistant/query/route.ts following the pattern of frontend/src/app/api/field-reports/[id]/review/route.ts for server-side rate-limiting and origin validation
frontend_request_routing.mobile_path: landslide-app/src/services/api/assistantApi.ts using apiClient with endpoint registered in API_CONFIG

schema_fields.sources: List of { title: str, source_type: str, url_or_slug: Optional[str], snippet: str, score: Optional[float] }

response_normalization_and_citations.rationale: Strict Pydantic response models ensure consistent frontend rendering and prevent raw LLM hallucinations from breaking client UI.

rate_limits_timeouts_and_errors.rate_limit_location: FastAPI route dependency or slowapi middleware on /api/assistant/query (e.g. 10 requests/minute per IP/session)
rate_limits_timeouts_and_errors.error_hierarchy: BackboardTimeoutError, BackboardRateLimitError, BackboardAPIError, caught in endpoint to return HTTP 504/429/502 with fallback static safety advice

pipeline_separation.isolation_boundary: Numerical ML risk prediction (XGBoost/GIS in /prediction) and visual hazard screening (Gemma/VLM in /api/field-reports) must remain strictly independent of Backboard RAG (/api/assistant).
pipeline_separation.rationale: Prevents LLM text hallucinations from corrupting quantitative geospatial risk calculations or certified geotechnical workflows.
